opportunities.title: Global EbA Fund - Medium-Size Grants Call for Proposals (first-ever call; General Track: Strategic Scaling and Global Influence), up to USD 500,000 / 24 months
opportunities.funder: Global EbA Fund (co-led by IUCN and UNEP; funded by Germany's International Climate Initiative, IKI / BMUKN)
opportunities.funding_text: Grant Size: each grant up to USD 500,000 (approx. 10 grants per secondary listings; number not confirmed on official page).
opportunities.duration: Project duration of 24 months or less
opportunities.eligible_applicants: NGOs, INGOs, IGOs, CBOs, Indigenous Peoples' Organisations, universities/academic institutions, research institutes/think tanks, private sector companies, and consortia. UNEP and IUCN offices not eligible; government entities may join consortia but cannot receive funds.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Project is Global, Thematic, or otherwise targets only ODA-eligible countries.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: IGOs and research institutes are explicitly listed as eligible; CIAT (international organization) or Bioversity International could lead or be co-applicant. Must build on existing EbA work.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: A clearly defined lead 'Applicant Organisation' that is the contract party; project must be built/based on existing work; at least three indicators from the Fund's Core Indicator Framework.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Global/thematic or ODA-eligible countries only (Colombia, Central America, Africa, Asia ODA countries qualify).
opportunities.consortium_details: Consortia allowed with a defined lead applicant; co-applicant mandate required for partners.
opportunities.cofunding_details: FAQ encourages seeking additional donors; no mandatory co-financing stated.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Three priority topics: (I) Innovative Finance Solutions for EbA; (II) EbA for Human Development and Security (fragile/conflict-affected contexts); (III) Interlinkages for people-nature-climate-land synergies across the Rio Conventions. Focus on removing systemic barriers to scaling EbA.
opportunities.required_documents: Applicant Declaration; Co-applicant Mandate; Medium-Size Grants Application Form; Theory of Change, Logframe and Project Activities Form; Project Proposal Budget Template; Due Diligence and Financial Capacity Questionnaire.
opportunities.application_procedure: Submit in English via the Fund's online platform ('All applications must be submitted on the online platform').
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: EbA / landscape adaptation is core to the Multifunctional Landscapes area; EO/AI/crop modelling can support evidence and investment-readiness (e.g., spatial targeting of EbA, climate-risk layers for innovative finance), but methods are secondary to the scaling/finance framing.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: IUCN/UNEP/IKI-backed, ODA focus, matches Alliance landscapes & adaptation mission; 'interlinkages' topic fits agroforestry/land restoration portfolio.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Feasible only if built on an existing Alliance EbA/landscape project; deadline in 6 days makes a new proposal very tight.
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue only if a landscape/EbA team already has a near-ready concept building on existing work (e.g., Colombia/Central America agroforestry or watershed EbA); otherwise monitor for the next medium-size round. Not a staff-salary-confirmed scheme - check the budget template.
opportunities.potential_partners: Alliance Multifunctional Landscapes team; national NGOs in ODA countries; IUCN regional offices as non-funded partners.
opportunities.next_action: By 12 Nov: check with Alliance landscapes/adaptation leads whether an existing EbA project can be scaled; download budget template to confirm personnel cost rules; submit by 16 Nov 2026.

evidence.eligibility_quote: NGOs, INGOs, IGOs, CBOs, Indigenous Peoples' Organisations, universities/academic institutions, research institutes/think tanks, private sector companies, and consortia ... UNEP and IUCN offices are not currently eligible to apply for funding.
evidence.status_quote: Medium-Size Grants Call for Proposals ... Grant Size: each grant up to USD 500,000 ... Project duration of 24 months or less
evidence.staff_costs_quote: Not specified on the call page; budget template not reviewed.

opportunities.title: Autodesk Foundation - rolling Discovery Form (Health & Resilience: climate adaptation technologies for low-resource communities, incl. agriculture), USD 100k-1M unrestricted grants
opportunities.program: Autodesk Foundation impact funding - Health & Resilience opportunity area
opportunities.deadline_text: No deadline; complete the Discovery Form, response within about three weeks; full application by invitation.
opportunities.funding_text: Our funding ranges from $100,000 to $1,000,000, with most commitments falling between $250,000 and $500,000. For nonprofits, we generally provide unrestricted grants.
opportunities.duration: Not specified (renewals at the end of each funding period are referenced)
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Nonprofits and startups using design, engineering or technology within the Foundation's impact opportunity areas.
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: Page does not address non-US or intergovernmental organizations; Alliance would need to confirm via the Discovery Form (US-registered affiliate or fiscal sponsor could be an option).
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Must work within one of the Foundation's impact opportunity areas ('thesis-driven approach').
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Not specified; Health & Resilience targets 'low-resource communities most vulnerable to climate change'.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Health & Resilience: 'improve resilience in low-resource communities most vulnerable to climate change' - focus areas include built environment, agriculture, energy access, water and sanitation.
opportunities.required_documents: Discovery Form (5-10 minutes); invited Application for Funding.
opportunities.application_procedure: Complete Discovery Form at autodesk.fluxx.io/apply/investment; Foundation invites a small selection to full application each year.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Technology-for-resilience framing fits digital advisory/climate-risk tools for smallholders, but funder emphasizes scaling organizations, not research.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Unrestricted, sizeable grants from a tech funder; agriculture explicitly in resilience focus; but the funder favours scaling nonprofits/startups.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Alliance could pitch an open-source digital climate-advisory / risk tool with scaling partners; low effort to submit Discovery Form.
opportunities.recommendation: Low-cost lead: submit a short Discovery Form framing an open digital climate-adaptation tool for smallholders (e.g., site-specific advisory) and ask about eligibility of international organizations.
opportunities.potential_partners: Alliance Digital Inclusion / climate services teams; scaling NGO partners in LAC/Africa.
opportunities.next_action: Submit Discovery Form; ask explicitly whether non-US international research organizations are eligible.

evidence.deadline_quote: The first step to be considered for Autodesk Foundation funding is to complete our Discovery Form.
evidence.eligibility_quote: We take a thesis-driven approach and therefore only consider organizations working within one of our impact opportunity areas.
evidence.status_quote: Each year we invite a small selection of organizations to fill out our Application for Funding.
evidence.staff_costs_quote: For nonprofits, we generally provide unrestricted grants.

opportunities.verification_notes: Loaded autodesk.org and autodesk.org/funding on 2026-11-10 (page content partially truncated). Lead surfaced via impactopen.org aggregator. Staff costs inferred from 'unrestricted' grants.
